annotations.text:
One construction for the decentralized.* family monogram — one device across .cloud, .exchange and .trade, with a per-sibling cue.

Shown as the family base, three derivations, both lockups at the old and new ratio, true 16/24/32px renders, a tile, one ink and a dark ground. It states its construction, what it is not, and its own cost.

The product routes cloud compute jobs and prices them with evidence: every quote carries the source that produced it, when it was observed, and when it stops being true.
